original_findings.title: Production pages compile Tailwind CSS in the browser
evidence: All seven sampled pages load https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tailwindcss/browser@4 as a blocking script. Observed compressed payload 58,993 bytes; resolved CDN version 4.3.5.
Mobile lab initial LCP candidates ranged 1.576–3.760s under 4× CPU / 150ms latency / 1.6Mbps down. One run per page; not real-user CWV.
Tailwind documentation describes Play CDN as development-only.
affected_pages: Homepage and all released pages using the shared Play CDN pattern
original_findings.expected_impact: Avoidable render work and reliance on a mutable third-party major-version alias. Exact savings must be benchmarked.
original_findings.recommended_action: In a later approved task, compile a small static stylesheet with pinned build dependencies; preserve current classes and layout. Stage this as a controlled change, with screenshots and functional tests.
original_findings.automation_potential: Build/check can be automated; first migration requires owner approval.
original_findings.verification_method: Repeat controlled cold/warm lab runs before and after on all seven page types; visual diff and complete functional/consent CI; check asset-size budgets. Reference: tailwind.
original_findings.description: Production pages compile Tailwind CSS in the browser

original_findings.title: Search reporting and actual indexing are not authenticated in this audit

evidence.detail: A Google site-verification meta tag exists; this is evidence of setup intent, not proof of current verified ownership, property access or indexed pages.

evidence: No authenticated GSC or GA4 reporting session/API result was available; no clicks, impressions, rankings, sessions or index coverage totals were read.
original_findings.expected_impact: Automatic traffic thresholds and prioritization cannot be calibrated from website HTML alone.
original_findings.recommended_action: Use owner-authorized Search Console read-only access or exports as a prerequisite to traffic monitoring. Verify the correct domain/URL-prefix property, date range, search type and data freshness. Record GA4 property reporting separately. Do not infer failure from absent access.
original_findings.automation_potential: Collection can be automated after credentials and property scope are approved.
original_findings.verification_method: Retrieve authenticated property list and bounded date-complete click/impression data; inspect representative URL indexed state and selected canonical; show source, property, retrieval time and missing-data state in reports.
original_findings.description: Search reporting and actual indexing are not authenticated in this audit

original_findings.automation_potential: Generate indexes/navigation deterministically from approved registry data; semantic category choices require review.
original_findings.verification_method: No-JavaScript link crawl, synonym search cases, legacy-card coverage, keyboard and 320px viewport checks.
original_findings.title: Homepage discovery depends on title-only search across a long undivided grid. Category data is not exposed as category navigation.

No explicit canonical preference across duplicate URL forms
evidence: All 87 released tool responses have zero rel=canonical tags and no canonical Link response header.
Both /slug/ and /slug/index.html returned 200 with identical bytes for all 87. Homepage / and /index.html also match; sampled query-string variant retains 200 and identical content.

evidence.detail: Framework declares canonical_path as directory_path + /index.html. Registry historical publication URLs frequently use trailing slashes; these are not SEO canonical tags.

original_findings.expected_impact: Explicit signals can reduce canonical ambiguity and make reporting consistent. This is not proof of duplicate-content penalties or indexing loss.
original_findings.recommended_action: In the approved foundation phase, store a single canonical_url per page and generate absolute HTTPS apex rel=canonical consistently in aliases, sitemap and metadata. Safest initial tool convention preserves the current framework /slug/index.html paths. Check Search Console selected canonicals before any deliberate convention change. Preserve all existing routes; do not use noindex on aliases or mass redirects as a shortcut.
original_findings.automation_potential: Generator/checker deterministic once owner-approved route policy is fixed; policy changes require review.
original_findings.verification_method: Assert one absolute canonical per released response, same target for its directory/index/query forms; target returns 200 and is indexable; compare sitemap/internal links and GSC user-declared versus Google-selected canonical where available.
original_findings.description: No explicit canonical preference across duplicate URL forms

original_findings.title: XML sitemap and generation pipeline are absent
evidence: No sitemap file or sitemap generation routine found in the inspected source tree. All 87 tools are nevertheless linked in homepage HTML.
original_findings.expected_impact: A registry-driven sitemap improves discovery diagnostics and completeness tracking as the catalog grows. A sitemap is not required for indexing and does not guarantee it.
original_findings.recommended_action: Generate a sitemap from RELEASED registry entries plus approved public hub/category/tutorial/privacy pages. Exclude planned, blocked, templates and audit files. Use only preferred canonical URLs and truthful content-change lastmod dates; avoid refreshing every URL date daily. Add a Sitemap directive in a small robots.txt. Authenticated submission is a later owner-authorized step.
original_findings.automation_potential: High after canonical and eligibility policy approval; initial implementation review required.
original_findings.verification_method: Parse XML and assert exact released URL-set equality (currently 87 tools), no duplicate/noncanonical/non-200 entries, no planned/blocked paths, valid escaping; check fetched deployed bytes and later GSC sitemap processing.
original_findings.description: XML sitemap and generation pipeline are absent

original_findings.title: Privacy-preserving GA4 settings limit acquisition attribution

evidence.detail: Both config and page_view supply page_location = location.origin + location.pathname and page_referrer = empty string; no campaign_* values are supplied.
Google documents that page_referrer is used to compute traffic source.

original_findings.expected_impact: Inference: new search/referral attribution and query-based campaign attribution may be incomplete under this privacy choice. The actual property channel totals were not inspected. Consent, blockers and distinct metric definitions already make GA4 sessions differ from GSC clicks.
original_findings.recommended_action: Preserve the current consent and sanitization behavior. Make GSC Web clicks the primary organic decline signal. If attribution is later required, design and separately approve a minimal sanitized source policy and verify it with a test property; never forward full referrer URLs, arbitrary query strings or user inputs by default.
original_findings.automation_potential: Read-only completeness checks are safe; changes to telemetry or consent always owner-approved.
original_findings.verification_method: Inspect real consented requests in a test property and validate property acquisition reports against known synthetic referral/campaign cases. Keep GSC clicks, consented GA4 page views and GA4 sessions separate; do not assume a 1:1 ratio.
original_findings.description: Privacy-preserving GA4 settings limit acquisition attribution

original_findings.title: Homepage small text falls below AA contrast
evidence: Browser computed-colour test found #resultCount and footer text at about 4.23:1 against #020617; 12px text needs 4.5:1. The placeholder banner caption measured approximately 2.58:1 before gradient effects, so that result needs visual confirmation.
Evidence: browser/interaction-results.json, homepage screenshots.
original_findings.expected_impact: Some supporting labels and links are harder to read. This is an accessibility issue, not a prediction of ranking loss.
original_findings.recommended_action: Raise muted-text contrast; test actual rendered colour pairs in every state. Keep disabled controls and decorative text exceptions separate.
original_findings.automation_potential: Deterministic contrast regression tests after an approved token change.
original_findings.verification_method: Recalculate ratios; inspect normal, hover, focus, selected and disabled states at 100%/200% zoom. Reference: contrast.
original_findings.description: Homepage small text falls below AA contrast

original_findings.title: The mobile homepage makes search and tools hard to reach

original_findings.expected_impact: More scrolling before starting a task; impact on engagement remains unmeasured.
original_findings.recommended_action: Move search and compact categories nearer the opening heading; shorten hero and remove or collapse unfilled advertising placeholders as an owner-approved design choice. Preserve equal consent choices.
original_findings.automation_potential: Layout changes require approval; measurements can be automated.
original_findings.verification_method: Task completion checks at 320/390px and desktop; keyboard navigation and consent overlay checks. No assumed conversion gain.

original_findings.expected_impact: Recognition and consistency can improve; no measured effect on trust or ranking.
original_findings.recommended_action: Use Everyday Digital Box as the proposed primary brand, subject to owner choice; define one wordmark, favicon family, header/footer and card template. Preserve tool names and URLs.
original_findings.automation_potential: Approved tokens and metadata can be generated; branding choices need approval.
original_findings.verification_method: Inventory all title suffixes/header/footer labels; visual review across legacy and modern pages.

original_findings.title: robots.txt is absent, without an observed crawl block

evidence.detail: HTTP 404; no blocking robots rules are served.

evidence: 87/87 tool responses have no noindex/nofollow robots meta, and none had an X-Robots-Tag header.
original_findings.expected_impact: No indexability failure follows from a missing robots.txt; the improvement is an explicit crawl policy and sitemap discovery.
original_findings.recommended_action: Add a minimal permissive robots.txt with the canonical sitemap URL as part of the foundation. Keep runtime scripts/styles crawlable. Do not treat robots disallow as privacy or deindexing.
original_findings.automation_potential: High for validation and restoring an approved deterministic file; blocking-rule changes always reviewed.
original_findings.verification_method: Fetch /robots.txt as text/plain; test the intended Googlebot rules against every released canonical URL and key assets; check no accidental Disallow: /.
original_findings.description: robots.txt is absent, without an observed crawl block

original_findings.title: Unique descriptions often omit useful capability detail
evidence: 65 of 87 unique tool descriptions are shorter than 70 characters; short length itself is not a Google rule violation.
original_findings.expected_impact: Specific, accurate benefit/mode/limit information may help prospective users choose the right utility. Search engines may rewrite descriptions.
original_findings.recommended_action: Review descriptions for the first 20 selected tools, adding the distinct task, relevant mode and true local-processing benefit. Use concise natural prose; do not enforce a fixed character-count target or pad with keywords.
original_findings.automation_potential: Detect missing/duplicates and provide suggestions automatically; owner/editor approves meaning.
original_findings.verification_method: Confirm generated descriptions remain unique, truthful and aligned with actual controls; compare query/page CTR only when sufficient GSC impressions exist.
original_findings.description: Unique descriptions often omit useful capability detail

original_findings.title: Social metadata and site/schema identity are absent
evidence: 0/87 tools has Open Graph, Twitter card or JSON-LD markup. Homepage also has none.
No microdata or RDFa schema declarations were found in released source pages.
original_findings.expected_impact: Sharing previews and explicit machine-readable identity can be improved; missing schema is not a general indexing failure.
original_findings.recommended_action: Generate OG title/description/url/site_name and a real licensed branded sharing image with dimensions; add Twitter summary/summary_large_image as appropriate. Start schema with homepage WebSite and truthful publisher identity, then visible breadcrumbs when category pages exist. Consider honest WebApplication descriptions without invented ratings.
original_findings.automation_potential: High for generation/validation after content and identity approval.
original_findings.verification_method: Check absolute resolvable asset URLs, meaningful alt text, card preview tools and JSON parsing; use Schema.org validator and supported Google Rich Results Test checks, then URL Inspection if access exists.
original_findings.description: Social metadata and site/schema identity are absent

original_findings.title: Shared favicon coverage is inconsistent

evidence.detail: HTTP 404; known historical optional issue remains.
Homepage declares an inline data-URL SVG W favicon. This is not a site-wide absence of an icon; most tool pages lack a shared icon declaration.

original_findings.expected_impact: A coherent shared favicon improves recognition in tabs and supported search displays; it does not establish rankings.
original_findings.recommended_action: Provide a simple owner-approved first-party icon URL and reference the intended sizes/formats consistently across the homepage and tools.
original_findings.automation_potential: Asset presence and dimensions automated; design reviewed.
original_findings.verification_method: Fetch each icon URL, validate MIME/dimensions and inspect actual tab rendering.

original_findings.title: Small controls and persistent privacy UI merit deeper manual testing
original_findings.status: partly confirmed; usability risk requires manual validation
evidence: DOM checks flag 13px checkbox boxes on CSV Data Cleaner and some short text links. Labels may enlarge the effective target and WCAG has spacing/inline exceptions; no blanket target-size failure established.
Privacy settings opens the panel and focuses Accept analytics. Escape leaves it visible. It is a non-modal section, not a declared dialog.
original_findings.expected_impact: A clearer close/return-focus pattern and generous hit areas may improve touch and keyboard use.
original_findings.recommended_action: Audit effective label hit areas and full keyboard sequence. Aim for 44px primary controls; ensure the banner never entirely covers focused controls. Keep the non-modal design coherent or intentionally implement a tested dialog pattern.
original_findings.automation_potential: Automated geometry checks plus manual keyboard/assistive technology review.
original_findings.verification_method: Test banner open/closed, both decisions, restored preferences, focus return, zoom, touch and screen readers. References: target, focus.
original_findings.description: Small controls and persistent privacy UI merit deeper manual testing
